replacements.Capacidad, uplift y ejecución son experi: Capability, uplift and execution are different experiments
replacements.Selecciona una capa. La misma respuesta: Select one layer. The same response can be relevant to one question and say almost nothing about the other two.
replacements.Evalúa capacidad base bajo una configura: Evaluate base capability under a declared configuration.
replacements.¿Cuánto mejora a una persona?: How much does it improve a person?
replacements.Compara una tarea con recursos normales: Compare a task with normal resources against assistance from the model.
replacements.<b>Medida:</b> diferencia observable en: Measure: observable difference in success, time or quality.
replacements.Incluye tools, scopes, autorización, est: Includes tools, scopes, authorization, state and recovery.
replacements.<b>Medida:</b> efecto externo y control: Measure: external effect and the control that stopped it.
replacements.<strong>Modelo:</strong> una salida peli: Model: a dangerous output measures model behavior; by itself it does not demonstrate a path to harm in production.
replacements.<strong>Uplift humano:</strong> la pregu: Human uplift: the question is how much model assistance changes what a person can accomplish relative to the baseline.
replacements.<strong>Producto:</strong> el resultado: Product: the relevant result is whether a trajectory crosses tools and authorization to produce a real effect.
replacements.<strong>Comparación:</strong> capability: Comparison: capability, uplift and execution are connected, but none of the three substitutes for the others.
